headword: {抗ウイルス薬|こうういるすやく}

definitions.explanation: A medication used to treat infections caused by viruses. Unlike antibiotics, which target bacteria, antiviral drugs work by inhibiting the ability of viruses to replicate.

examples.english: Antiviral drugs are effective against influenza.
